guide.q01.question.value: Is editor harm more than a repeated evaluation produces?
guide.q01.question.match: Is editor harm more than a repeated evaluation produces? & Yes. In \swrBaseNullHarm\% of pairs a repeated base run fails where the first run succeeded; the 112-task editors harm \swrHarmLTwo\% (L2) to \swrHarmLThree\% (L3) of pairs. & \ref{app:sw-robustness-repeat} \\

guide.q01.answer.value: Yes. In 1.8–2.3% of pairs a repeated base run fails where the first run succeeded; the 112-task editors harm 4.8–5.7% (L2) to 10.2–10.9% (L3) of pairs.
guide.q01.answer.match: Is editor harm more than a repeated evaluation produces? & Yes. In \swrBaseNullHarm\% of pairs a repeated base run fails where the first run succeeded; the 112-task editors harm \swrHarmLTwo\% (L2) to \swrHarmLThree\% (L3) of pairs. & \ref{app:sw-robustness-repeat} \\

guide.q02.question.value: Do the recipe differences hold across training seeds?
guide.q02.question.match: Do the recipe differences hold across training seeds? & At 16 source tasks, L3 is below L1 and L2 in all three seeds, and L1 and L2 are within seed variation. At 112 source tasks and 121.25k updates, L2 exceeds L3 in both seeds; from seed 0 to seed 1, L2 changes by \swrHxSeedDiffTwo{} points and L3 by \swrHxSeedDiffThree{} points. & \ref{app:sw-robustness-seeds16}, \ref{app:sw-robustness-seeds112} \\
guide.q02.question.note: number macros replaced by their generated values
